updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Data Security Triage Agent Confidence Scoring and Reasoning Trace
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in DLP now provides confidence scores and reasoning traces for each triaged alert, enabling analysts to understand and trust automation decisions without falling back to manual review. This transparency improves SOC efficiency by surfacing explainable, auditable outputs alongside agent recommendations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: DLP now supports a File Quarantine action that automatically moves non-compliant files to an admin-controlled restricted location, immediately revoking all user access while preserving the file for investigation. This provides immediate containment of sensitive data exposure and prevents further sharing or misuse.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Policy Tips Support in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips are now available in Microsoft Outlook for Mac, notifying users in real time when email contains sensitive information that violates policy, with options to remove non-compliant recipients or request override. This extends compliance enforcement to macOS users before they send non-compliant emails.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Decouple Policy Tips and Email Notifications for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Admins can now independently configure whether DLP displays policy tips, sends email notifications, both, or neither for SharePoint and OneDrive rules, rather than being forced to enable both together. This flexibility allows organizations to tailor user experience and notification strategies per rule.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logs for the Microsoft Purview portal now provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot authorization issues and monitor who accessed what and why. This improves governance and compliance documentation of administrative access.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Select User-Owned SharePoint Embedded Containers
updates.summary: eDiscovery users can now view and select SharePoint Embedded content containers owned by a specific person, including content from Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks, expanding data source coverage. This ensures modern collaborative content is included in legal holds and investigations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Customer-Managed Key for Direct Export
updates.summary: eDiscovery direct export now supports customer-managed key (CMK) encryption, allowing organizations to manage their own encryption keys for exported data in addition to Microsoft-managed encryption. This meets heightened compliance requirements for organizations requiring full encryption key control.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Alert Summaries in Microsoft Defender XDR
updates.summary: DLP alerts with Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations are now available in Microsoft Defender XDR, centralizing security alert visibility and investigation workflows. This integration streamlines SOC operations by consolidating compliance and security alerts in one platform.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle: Retention Based on Last Accessed Date
updates.summary: Retention policies can now apply to SharePoint and OneDrive files based on when they were last accessed by users, enabling smarter retention of infrequently used or stale content. This helps organizations retain active content while removing old, unused files in compliance with data governance policies.

updates.title: CVE-2026-49179: Windows Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution
updates.summary: A command injection vulnerability in Windows Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network by exploiting improper input sanitization. Admins should apply security updates immediately as this could allow unauthenticated remote compromise of AD infrastructure.

updates.title: 2 Microsoft SharePoint Server Authorization Vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-62827, CVE-2026-63512)
updates.summary: Two authorization flaws in Microsoft Office SharePoint—one allowing elevation of privilege and another enabling tampering—allow authenticated attackers to exceed their permissions over the network. Organizations should patch SharePoint farms to prevent lateral privilege escalation and unauthorized data modification.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Auto-Labeling Policy Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Admins can now run auto-labeling policies in simulation mode before enforcement to preview which items would be labeled and review match results and source distribution without making changes. This reduces risk of misconfigured policies affecting production data and improves confidence before enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Auto-Labeling Policy Insights Tab
updates.summary: A new Insights tab in auto-labeling policy details provides at-a-glance performance metrics showing how the policy identifies and labels content in real time, with different views for simulation versus enforcement mode. This helps admins assess labeling effectiveness and troubleshoot policy behavior.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Network Data Security with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access enables organizations to intercept, inspect, and enforce policies on text and AI interactions at the network layer, preventing sensitive data leakage to untrusted cloud apps, browsers, and generative AI platforms. This protects data outside traditional SaaS boundaries and adds network-level compliance enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Unified Alert Dashboard
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now combines Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single unified alerts list, allowing analysts to view and manage both classic and AI-triaged alerts in one location with preview of summaries and user details. This streamlines alert management and reduces context-switching for investigators.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Expanded Microsoft Entra User Profile Details
updates.summary: The unified alert experience now displays additional user profile signals from Microsoft Entra, including office location, employee type, department, and last working date, providing investigators with richer context during alert triage. This enables smarter risk assessment and faster investigation prioritization based on user attributes.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Expanded Note Capabilities
updates.summary: Analysts can now add and view notes on both alerts and cases, with automatic system-generated notes when status, assignment, closure, or escalation changes occur. This improves collaboration and audit trails for investigation workflows.
